scripts.deploy: bun run db:migrate:remote && cd app && bun run build && cd ../worker && bunx wrangler deploy --tag $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd worker && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply verbum-vitae --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd worker && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply verbum-vitae --remote
scripts.check: bun run check:ts && bun run check:biome
scripts.check:biome: biome check app/src app/index.html worker/src packages --write
scripts.check:ts: cd packages/shared && bunx tsc && cd ../../worker && bunx tsc && cd ../app && bunx tsc -b
